conditional_interval_result: In each 120-replicate scenario, first-hypermean null rejections remain 4/120 (IID two predictors), 12/120 (IID nine predictors), and 8/120 (spatial-error stress). Nine-predictor conditional 95% interval coverage is 90%; these intervals are not admitted as final ecological inference.

fullscale_execution.source: generated independent synthetic arrays; no real observations or environmental matrix read

initial_failure: All four L-BFGS-B attempts reported relative-objective convergence but failed the unchanged 1e-4 absolute projected-score threshold. The original run and deterministic reproduction are preserved; no estimate was admitted from them.
numerical_correction: Analytic-score polishing at a reported minimum, with original bounds, starts, score threshold, positive free-coordinate curvature and non-worse objective. The same full-size generated data now meets the original threshold; no statistical criterion was relaxed.
rank_boundary: All 32 supplied taxa, including a singleton and a locally aliased taxon, were retained in every estimable replicate. A pooled prediction for an uninformative taxon is not an independently estimated local slope.
remaining: Component/spatial joint resampling and its null/coverage validation
Production assessability and qualified measurement-formulation propagation
replication_boundary: The second 360-replicate execution repeats the same seeds and scenarios after a numerical correction. It is a paired regression check, not 360 additional independent replicates or a new calibration sample.
source: Generated synthetic arrays only; zero empirical trait-environment values read.
